proposition: The Mokobara Transit Backpack carries everything a man needs to get home: thirty litres that swallow more than looks possible.

board.style_line: Photoreal vertical 9:16 film still, small tropical island beach, low warm afternoon sun as the single key from camera-left with soft skylight fill, high key, sand and sea graded down to muted warm neutrals so the one saturated colour in frame is the bag's yellow lining, matte skin and fabric, 35 mm cinematic look, shallow but not blurred depth, natural grain.
board.negative_line: No text, no logos, no readable lettering, no captions, no subtitles, no watermarks, no brand marks, no signage; no famous faces, no film characters, no helmets, armour, mythological creatures, sirens, giants or ancient ships; no second bag; no extra people; no distorted hands or fingers.

identity_anchors.transit_backpack: Mokobara Transit Backpack, 30 litres: deep navy matte body with no sheen, bright yellow lining visible wherever it is open, one vertical front zip and a front bucket pocket, each zip carrying two small black zip pulls, black padded shoulder straps, a small black top grab handle; compact boxy commuter shape that stands upright on its base.
identity_anchors.castaway: Indian man about thirty-five, lean and sun-darkened, long untrimmed black beard streaked grey, hair tied back with twine, torn faded grey cotton shirt open at the chest, trousers cut off ragged at the knee, barefoot, coir rope as a belt; the same face, beard and clothes in every beat.
identity_anchors.island: Small uninhabited tropical island: pale fine sand, turquoise shallows, a line of coconut palms, driftwood at the tideline, long shadows from a low sun at camera-left; no buildings, no boats except the driftwood raft, no other people.
identity_anchors.photograph: A small creased colour photograph, palm-sized, of a smiling Indian woman about thirty in a plain pale-blue cotton kurta in sunlight, plain background, no place recognisable; the same face each time it appears.

hero_frame.description: Last frame of beat 5: the Transit Backpack stands upright on pale sand, fully packed and zipped, its square navy shape unbulged, the front bucket pocket open a finger's width so a slit of yellow lining shows with the corner of the photograph tucked inside; a weathered hand rests on the small top grab handle; beside it on the sand, the empty space where a heap of coconuts, rope, fish and water tube lay a moment ago; the sea line in the upper third. One frame says the whole load went in and the bag is ready to go home.

audio.music_bed: Silence but for surf, wind and one gull for beats 1 and 2; a single sustained low string enters under the photograph (beat 3, about 9 s) once the emotion is already on his face; it gains a slow walking pulse through the packing (beat 5) and the walk to the raft (beat 6); resolves to one held warm chord under the close (beat 7). Diegetic foley throughout: zip, sand, the thud of each item into the bag, footsteps in wet sand. Surf continues under every beat because every beat is the same place.

beats.title: Tideline
beats.feeling: A jolt: something clean and modern lying where nothing modern should be.
beats.framing: Tight close-up, camera resting on the sand at the wet tideline. The bag lies on its side half-buried in the lower-centre zone, top grab handle toward camera, one black strap trailing across wet sand. A thin sheet of foam slides over its base and pulls back. Upper zone: soft turquoise shallows. At about 2.5 s a sun-cracked, bearded man's hand enters from frame-left and closes around the grab handle.
beats.first_frame: Navy matte bag body crusted with a line of dried salt and sand, the front bucket pocket unzipped a finger's width so a slit of bright yellow lining shows, two black zip pulls catching the low sun, black strap across wet sand, the foam edge just touching the bag's base; no hand yet.
beats.impact: Locked-off low camera; the surprise is the object, so nothing moves but water. Sound: surf, wind, one gull, no music. The hand's entry is the motivation to leave the shot. Held four seconds, longer than the frame takes to describe aloud.

beats.title: Recognition
beats.feeling: Disbelief tipping into a laugh he has not used in years.
beats.framing: Medium shot at his kneeling eye height, camera on the sea side of the line; land and palms are screen-left, sea is screen-right, and this holds for the whole film. The castaway kneels screen-left facing the bag, which now stands upright in the lower-right zone. He brushes sand off the navy body with his forearm, then draws the vertical front zip down: the yellow lining opens like a lit window in the navy. His face lifts.
beats.first_frame: Kneeling castaway with both hands on the shoulders of the sand-dusted bag, zip closed, his face bent toward it, low sun from camera-left raking his beard and the matte navy body, pale sand and a palm trunk behind.
beats.impact: One hidden move: a slow push-in that begins only as his hands pull the zip, so the move sits behind the action. The zip's rasp leads the picture. The yellow reveal is the beat's single cue; the wordmark super arrives lower-third over pale sand at 5 s so the brand is named inside ten seconds.

beats.title: The photograph
beats.feeling: Grief and gladness in the same breath: the reason to go.
beats.framing: Two shots. First, close-up over his right shoulder down into the open bag: yellow lining fills the lower half of frame, his fingers lift the creased photograph from the inner zip pocket into the upper-centre zone. Cut on the lift to a tight close-up of his face, eyes wet, the yellow-lined mouth of the bag at the bottom edge of frame. Both setups from the sea side of the line; his look goes down-right to the bag and the bag sits down-right of him.
beats.first_frame: His hand inside the bag, yellow lining wrapping the wrist, the corner of the photograph just emerging between finger and thumb, out-of-focus pale sand beyond, low sun from the left.
beats.impact: Cut on the movement of the photograph rising. The single low string enters under the face close-up, after the emotion is already made. Face held two seconds; then his eyes drop back to the open bag, which opens the gap the next beat fills: what else is in there.

beats.title: The arm
beats.feeling: The laugh: the bag is deeper than the man.
beats.framing: Medium-wide at standing chest height, camera on the sea side. The castaway sits on the sand with the open bag upright between his knees in the lower-centre zone, palms and clear bright sky behind and above. He reaches in for the next thing and his arm sinks to the elbow, then to the shoulder, his cheek pressed against the top grab handle. He stops and turns his face straight to camera, eyebrows up. The upper-right zone of sky stays empty for the super.
beats.first_frame: Castaway seated, right arm in the open bag to the elbow, left hand steadying the navy body, mouth open mid-breath, low sun lighting the yellow-lined mouth of the bag, bare pale sky above.
beats.impact: Locked-off static wide with the subject blocked to face camera; the joke needs a still frame and the performance does everything. The 30L super appears in the upper-right zone as he looks at us: the flat truth beside the exaggeration. Sound: the string holds; a small rummage-and-clink foley from deep inside the bag.

beats.title: Packing
beats.framing: Static wide, camera low on the sand, sea side. The bag stands upright in the lower-centre zone, front zip fully open. From frame-left he brings in and pushes down, one after another: three green coconuts, a leaf-wrapped bundle of dried fish, a coil of coir rope, a bamboo water tube, a flint blade, a folded palm-leaf mat. The bag takes each one without bulging. Last, the photograph slips into the front bucket pocket. Both black zip pulls are drawn shut and his hand comes to rest on the top grab handle. The last frame is the hero frame.
beats.first_frame: The empty open bag upright, yellow lining blazing inside the navy, a heap of coconuts, rope, fish bundle and water tube on the sand to its left, his bare feet at the left frame edge, the sea line in the upper third.
beats.impact: One shot, no move: the comedy is in the count and the eye must be free to watch the heap shrink. Foley: each item thuds in, the zips run home. The string picks up a slow walking pulse. The closed bag with his hand on the handle holds for a full two seconds before the cut.

beats.title: Going home
beats.feeling: Lift: he is already halfway back to her.
beats.framing: Wide at hip height on the sea side, tracking laterally with him as he walks from frame-left across pale sand into the shallows toward a small driftwood raft with a sail made of a torn grey shirt, moored at frame-right. The bag sits square on his back, straps snug, the darkest shape in a bright frame. Footprints in wet sand behind him. The lower-left zone of sand stays clear for the super.
beats.first_frame: Castaway mid-stride at the left third, bag square on his back with both black straps taut, the raft small at the right edge, sun from camera-left throwing his long shadow across the sand toward the water.
beats.impact: A lateral track motivated by the moving figure; screen direction left-to-right held from beat 2. Music at its full walking pulse, surf rising under. The light lifts a little with the dramatic line. The product name super sits lower-left over sand at 22 to 26 s.

beats.title: Brand close
beats.feeling: Certainty, and where to get one.
beats.framing: Code-composed. The beat-5 hero still held full frame: packed navy bag upright on pale sand, slit of yellow at the front pocket, hand on the handle, sea line in the upper third. Supplied wordmark placed unaltered in the upper zone over sky and sea; the product name and capacity in the lower-middle zone over sand; the web address in the bottom zone.
beats.first_frame: The hero still with all four composed elements already in place; nothing animates.
beats.impact: Hard cut in. Music resolves to one held warm chord; surf continues under because it is the same beach. Four-second hold, longer than the card takes to read aloud.

sources.mokobara_wordmark: brief.reference_assets asset_id mokobara_wordmark (SVG, sha256 c443658f13bed93aa1adbb6bcbc5fcbb06fc4d9abdafd0f59f5da593c67356eb), placed as supplied, never redrawn or recoloured; if the supplied colour measures under 3:1 on its ground, the brand's own higher-contrast variant is requested, never a recolour

brand_mark_early.why: Name the brand inside ten seconds, at the moment of recognition; lower-third zone over pale sand, opposite the castaway's face at the top of the long axis; contrast measured on the delivered frame at its darkest and lightest sand pixel, target at least 3:1 for the mark.

capacity_super.why: The flat statement beside the spin: the arm-to-the-shoulder gag is an exaggeration of a true figure, thirty litres. Upper-right zone over clear sky, opposite the bag at the bottom of the long axis; deep navy text (#1B2A4A) bold sans, mixed case as supplied, measured at least 4.5:1 against the lightest and darkest sky pixel under the letters, or thickened until it does.

product_name_super.why: Name the product as it is seen in use on his back; lower-left zone over pale sand, opposite the raft at the right edge; same navy bold sans, measured at least 4.5:1 on the sand pixels under the letters across the whole track.

close_card.why: End on the pack with the name, the product, the one figure and the one place to act; three type ranks only (wordmark, product name plus capacity, web address); every string composed by code, none generated; each measured on its ground.

mandatory.realisation: A 30 s Mokobara product film: the Transit Backpack is in every beat from frame one, the supplied wordmark is placed at 5 s and on the close, and the film ends on the packed bag.

mandatory.realisation: The story shape is borrowed, not the property: a man marooned for years sets out home to his wife. Realised as an original castaway on an unnamed tropical island with a driftwood raft; no title, name, character, line, creature, costume or ship design from any film or poem.

mandatory.customer_words: the proatagonist had mokbara bags. the protagonist found his mokobara bag, while he was on the island where he was kept for years
mandatory.realisation: Beat 1 finds the bag washed up at the tideline; beat 2 shows the years on him (grey-streaked beard, torn shirt, rope belt) as he recognises it and opens it.

mandatory.customer_words: in that bag he founds her wives photo
mandatory.realisation: Beat 3: the creased photograph of his wife comes out of the inner pocket; her face and his wet eyes are the film's emotional hinge and the reason he leaves.

mandatory.customer_words: a lot of stuff that he could use to go back
mandatory.realisation: Beat 4 opens the gap (what else is in there); beat 5 shows rope, blade, water tube, mat and food going in, the kit of a crossing.

mandatory.realisation: Beat 5 packs coconuts and dried fish with the gear; beat 6 walks him, bag on back, into the shallows toward the raft.

mandatory.realisation: Seven contiguous beats totalling 30 s in 9:16 with native audio; the identity anchor restates all four invariants verbatim in every prompt and the yellow lining is the film's one saturated colour.

The wordmark file is placed unaltered at 5 s and on the close; the product photo is the likeness reference for every still and the identity anchor is written from it.

brand_timeline.in_context: The product itself is on screen from t 0 and in every beat (bag at tideline, opened, the yellow-lined mouth under his face, between his knees, packed, on his back, on the close). Wordmark super 5 to 8 s; 30L super 13.5 to 16.5 s; Transit Backpack super 22 to 26 s; full brand card 26 to 30 s.
brand_timeline.spoken: none; the film has no voice-over or dialogue, so the name is never spoken (declared in deviations)

last_frame: The beat-5 hero still held: packed navy Transit Backpack upright on pale sand, slit of yellow lining at the front pocket with the photograph's corner, his hand on the top grab handle, sea line in the upper third; supplied wordmark in the upper zone, Transit Backpack and 30L in the lower-middle zone, mokobara.com in the bottom zone.
